attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence — which one entry on this day does carry, and that one was refused. The entry is one sentence and a couplet: Saint Mark bore witness by the sword; we have no other details of his life. There is no year, no reign, no place and no companion, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`, and no hymn is printed. The corpus keeps many men of this name and none on this day; the slug carries the day because the page gives nothing else to tell him apart by.
